mapper.sql: (select p.pack_id, count(1) asset_contract_count, sum(p.uncollected_due_amount) uncollected_due_amount, sum(p.collected_due_amount) collected_due_amount, sum(p.uncollected_principal) uncollected_principal, sum(p.collected_principal) collected_principal, sum(p.uncollected_interest) uncollected_interest, sum(p.collected_interest) collected_interest, sum(p.overdue_count) overdue_count from ( select caap.pack_id, caap.package_id, nvl(sum( case when (caap.times_from <= con.times and caap.times_to >= con.times ) then con.uncollected_due_amount else 0 end),0) uncollected_due_amount, nvl(sum( case when (caap.times_from <= con.times and caap.times_to >= con.times ) then con.collected_due_amount else 0 end),0) collected_due_amount, nvl(sum( case when (caap.times_from <= con.times and caap.times_to >= con.times ) then con.uncollected_principal else 0 end),0) uncollected_principal, nvl(sum( case when (caap.times_from <= con.times and caap.times_to >= con.times ) then con.collected_principal else 0 end),0) collected_principal, nvl(sum( case when (caap.times_from <= con.times and caap.times_to >= con.times ) then con.uncollected_interest else 0 end),0) uncollected_interest, nvl(sum( case when (caap.times_from <= con.times and caap.times_to >= con.times ) then con.collected_interest else 0 end),0) collected_interest, nvl(sum( case when (caap.times_from <= con.times and caap.times_to >= con.times ) then ( case when con.overdue_status='Y' then 1 else 0 end ) else 0 end),0) overdue_count from ct_abs_assets_package caap join ( select fc.contract_id, 'FCT_CONTRACT' con_document_category, ca.quotation_cashflow_id cashflow_id, ca.times, nvl(ca.due_amount,0)-nvl(ca.received_amount,0) uncollected_due_amount, nvl(ca.due_amount,0) collected_due_amount, case when ca.cf_item=54 then nvl(ca.due_amount,0)-nvl(ca.received_amount,0) else 0 end uncollected_principal, case when ca.cf_item=54 then nvl(ca.due_amount,0) else 0 end collected_principal, case when ca.cf_item=55 then nvl(ca.due_amount,0)-nvl(ca.received_amount,0) else 0 end uncollected_interest, case when ca.cf_item=55 then nvl(ca.due_amount,0) else 0 end collected_interest, ca.overdue_status from fct_contract fc join fct_quotation_cashflow ca on fc.contract_id=ca.contract_id where fc.data_class='NORMAL' and ca.cf_status = 'RELEASE' and ca.cf_direction = 'INFLOW' and ca.cf_item in(54,55) union select fc.contract_id, 'CON_CONTRACT' con_document_category, ca.cashflow_id, ca.times, nvl(ca.due_amount,0)-nvl(ca.received_amount,0) uncollected_due_amount, nvl(ca.due_amount,0) collected_due_amount, nvl(ca.principal,0)-nvl(ca.received_principal,0) uncollected_principal, nvl(ca.principal,0) collected_principal, nvl(ca.interest,0)-nvl(ca.received_interest,0) uncollected_interest, nvl(ca.interest,0) collected_interest, ca.overdue_status from con_contract fc join con_contract_cashflow ca on fc.contract_id=ca.contract_id where fc.data_class='NORMAL' and ca.cf_status = 'RELEASE' and ca.cf_direction = 'INFLOW' and ca.cf_item =1) con on caap.contract_id=con.contract_id and caap.con_document_category=con.con_document_category where 1=1 group by caap.pack_id, caap.package_id ) p group by p.pack_id )

(select pa.pack_id, count(1) asset_rent_count from ( select distinct caap.pack_id, con.bp_id from ct_abs_assets_package caap join ( select fc.contract_id, 'FCT_CONTRACT' con_document_category, pb.bp_id from fct_contract fc join fct_project_bp pb on pb.project_id=fc.project_id and pb.bp_role_type='SELLER' where fc.data_class='NORMAL' union select fc.contract_id, 'CON_CONTRACT' con_document_category, pb.bp_id from con_contract fc join prj_project_bp pb on pb.project_id=fc.project_id and pb.bp_categroy='CON_CONTRACT' and pb.bp_type='TENANT' where fc.data_class='NORMAL' ) con on caap.contract_id=con.contract_id and caap.con_document_category=con.con_document_category) pa group by pa.pack_id)
mapper.select: select ap.project_status, count(ap.project_id) project_count, count(ap.project_id)/(select count(*) from ct_abs_project c where c.company_id = #{request.companyId})*100 project_count_percent, (select count(*) from ct_abs_project a where a.company_id = #{request.companyId}) project_sum from ct_abs_project ap where ap.company_id = #{request.companyId} group by ap.project_status

select cap.project_number, cap.project_name, (select su.description from sys_user su where su.user_id = cap.user_id ) create_person, caap.base_date, pack.* from ct_abs_project cap join ct_abs_assets_pack caap on cap.pack_id=caap.pack_id join pack on pack.pack_id = caap.pack_id where cap.project_status='APPROVED'
and (cap.project_name like concat('%',concat(#{projectNumber},'%')) or cap.project_number like concat('%',concat(#{projectNumber},'%')))
select count(1) from ct_abs_product cap where cap.data_class='NORMAL' and cap.project_id = #{projectId}
